name: 5 mm LED holder, screw-in bezel
summary: Chrome ring that holds a 5 mm indicator LED in a panel. Needs a 7 mm round hole.
source: The 5 mm LED itself is a fixed size, but the holders sold for it are not. This entry describes the common chrome bezel type with a threaded barrel and a nut on the inside, which wants a 7 mm hole. Other holders you will find need 6.4 mm (plastic snap-in), 7.9 mm, or 8 mm, and the barrel length and bezel height vary between suppliers. Measure the holder in your hand before you drill.

keepouts.label: Room for the LED legs and wires
Room for the bezel sticking out of the panel

electrical.note: An LED is not a lamp: it must have a series resistor or it will burn out. Forward voltage is roughly 2 V for red, yellow or green and 3.2 V for blue or white, at about 20 mA.
